description: Show a message as a pop-up on the CardputerZero's own screen (320x170 LCD). This is the ONLY way to put text on that screen: system.run cannot draw on it (the display is a framebuffer owned by the Muse Gadget app, not a terminal). Use it whenever the owner asks to show, display, notify or put something on the CardputerZero / device screen. The Muse Gadget app must be open. Japanese is fine; keep it under about 120 characters.

text.description: The message to show on the screen.
